supplements.title: Type 2 diabetes remission in gynaecologic oncology patients completing an acute preoperative weight loss protocol: a case series.
supplements.summary: Gynaecologic cancer patients with obesity who lost weight before surgery experienced remission or improvement in their type 2 diabetes.

supplements.title: Integrative bioinformatics and experimental validation reveal quercetin as a potential multi-target therapeutic agent in hepatocellular carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Quercetin, a natural compound, reduces liver cancer cell growth by targeting five key genes involved in tumor development.

supplements.title: ROS-mediated apoptosis in colon cancer cells induced by sulfated polysaccharides from Gracilaria corticata.
supplements.summary: Sulfated polysaccharides from red algae trigger colon cancer cell death through oxidative stress mechanisms.

supplements.title: In-silico prediction of multi‑target mechanisms of Pinellia ternata phytochemicals in lung cancer: Evidence from a graph‑attention‑guided virtual screening and multi‑scale simulations.
supplements.summary: Computational analysis identifies baicalein from Pinellia ternata as a promising multi-target compound against lung cancer by targeting key proteins like PTK2 and KDR.

supplements.title: Phytosomes against melanoma: disrupting molecular pathways with targeted phytochemical delivery.
supplements.summary: Phytosomes—nanoparticles delivering plant compounds—overcome poor absorption to effectively target melanoma through multiple cancer pathways.

supplements.title: Exploring the anticancer potential of Streptomyces sp. M4 extract: effects on apoptosis in gastric cancer ags cells.
supplements.summary: Streptomyces sp. M4 extract kills gastric cancer cells by triggering apoptosis through the extrinsic death pathway.

supplements.title: Platycodin D Overcomes Cisplatin Resistance in Gastric Cancer by Inducing Ferroptosis through TLK1-Dependent UHRF2/DNMT3A/ALOX15 Pathway.
supplements.summary: Platycodin D helps overcome cisplatin resistance in gastric cancer by triggering a specific cell death pathway.

supplements.title: Molecular mechanism of aloe emodin in combating nasopharyngeal carcinoma revealed through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vitro experiments.
supplements.summary: Aloe emodin inhibits nasopharyngeal cancer by blocking the EGFR/SRC/STAT3 signaling pathway and reducing tumor-promoting protein expression.

supplements.title: (Poly)phenol profiles of plant-based diets assessed through dietary intake and urinary biomarkers.
supplements.summary: Plant-based diets contain significantly higher levels of protective plant compounds called polyphenols compared to omnivorous diets.

supplements.title: A comparative experimental study on the impact of radiotherapy dose rate and melatonin pretreatment in tongue and esophageal tissues.
supplements.summary: Melatonin pretreatment reduced radiation damage in tongue and esophageal tissues when treated with different radiotherapy beam types.

supplements.title: Integrated HPLC-ESI-QTOF-MS based characterization and biological evaluation of Alkanna orientalis and Alkanna verecunda roots.
supplements.summary: Alkanna orientalis root extract showed mild cytotoxic activity against gastric, ovarian, colon, and cervical cancer cells while remaining non-toxic to normal cells.

supplements.title: Myricetin Attenuates Lipopolysaccharide-Induced Acute Lung Injury by Suppressing Pyroptosis via Activation of the Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Myricetin reduces acute lung injury by suppressing cell death and oxidative stress through activation of protective cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Physalis minima L.: A comprehensive review on phytochemistry, pharmacology, and food applications.
supplements.summary: Physalis minima plant contains withanolides showing promise against cancer, inflammation, and neuroinflammatory conditions, requiring further research.

supplements.title: Comprehensive scientific insights on plant inspired nano therapeutics as the missing piece of the breast cancer puzzle.
supplements.summary: Plant-based nanoparticles show promise as a safer, less toxic alternative treatment for breast cancer compared to conventional chemotherapy.

supplements.title: A novel Umezawaea tangerina endophyte reveals anti-colorectal cancer activity and a rich biosynthetic landscape.
supplements.summary: A bacterial strain produces an extract that kills colorectal cancer cells by triggering apoptosis, rivaling the standard chemotherapy drug 5-fluorouracil.

off_label.title: A phenothiazine analog, PTF, suppresses breast cancer growth by inhibiting YAP signaling.
off_label.summary: PTF, a modified phenothiazine compound, effectively kills breast cancer cells by blocking YAP signaling and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with cancer are associated with reduced all-cause mortality and hospitalization.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonist drugs reduce death and hospital stays in cancer patients.

off_label.title: Equilibrium and non-equilibrium thermodynamics in drug repurposing: Machine learning-guided discovery of high-affinity WEE1 kinase inhibitors.
off_label.summary: Machine learning identified existing drugs like acarbose that effectively inhibit WEE1 kinase, a cancer cell cycle target, through computational screening.

off_label.title: Changes in metabolic and pulmonary outcomes after discontinuation of glucagon-like-peptide-1 receptor agonist therapy in people with cystic fibrosis.
off_label.summary: Stopping GLP-1 drugs in cystic fibrosis patients reversed weight loss and worsened blood sugar control and lung function.

off_label.title: Canonical microRNA loss drives tumor development, implicating therapeutic efficacy of enoxacin in angiosarcoma.
off_label.summary: Loss of microRNA processing drives angiosarcoma development, and the antibiotic enoxacin restores tumor-suppressive miRNAs to slow cancer growth.

off_label.title: Novel statin derivatives as non-competitive inhibitors of human adenylate kinase 1: synthesis, enzyme inhibition, molecular docking, and biological studies.
off_label.summary: Novel statin-based compounds selectively inhibit adenylate kinase 1, showing promise as therapeutic agents with potential applications in cancer and other diseases.

off_label.title: Pre-treatment of cabozantinib prior to hypofractionated radiotherapy increases immunomodulatory effects and tumor size reduction in a 4T1 breast cancer murine model.
off_label.summary: Combining cabozantinib with radiotherapy reduces breast cancer tumors and boosts anti-tumor immune responses in mice.

off_label.title: Prenatal Diagnosis and Management of Kaposiform Hemangioendothelioma With Kasabach-Merritt Phenomenon: Imaging Features and First Experience With Maternal Sirolimus Therapy.
off_label.summary: Pregnant woman received a drug called sirolimus to treat a rare blood vessel tumor in the fetus, successfully managing a life-threatening bleeding complication.

off_label.title: Emerging concepts, hot topics, and open questions in today's pancreatic cancer research.
off_label.summary: Pancreatic cancer researchers identify emerging approaches—including microenvironment studies, immunotherapy, and microbiome research—to improve survival rates.

off_label.title: The retinol metabolizing enzyme DHRS3 coordinates antigen presentation, endothelial stability, and cholesterol metabolism to suppress hepatocellular carcinoma progression.
off_label.summary: DHRS3 protein suppresses liver cancer growth by boosting immunity and blocking metastasis, with a drug combination showing promise.

off_label.title: Innovations in Obesity Treatment: Beyond Adipose Tissue Dysfunction.
off_label.summary: Obesity drives cancer through chronic inflammation and insulin dysfunction; new treatments targeting appetite hormones and fat metabolism show promise.

off_label.title: Discovery of novel anthraquinone-based P2X7R antagonist that reinvigorates anti-tumor immunity and overcomes PD-1 resistance in breast cancer.
off_label.summary: A new breast cancer drug candidate blocks P2X7R to shrink tumors and restore immune response, even overcoming resistance to existing immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Emerging trends in implication of nanocarriers in repolarization of tumor associated macrophages for improved triple negative breast cancer therapy.
off_label.summary: Nanocarriers can reprogram tumor-supporting immune cells to fight triple negative breast cancer more effectively.

off_label.title: Combination of ivermectin and metformin promotes autophagy in MCF‑7 cells by inhibiting phosphorylation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.
off_label.summary: Combining ivermectin and metformin kills breast cancer cells by triggering autophagy through increased oxidative stress and pathway inhibition.

off_label.title: The role of ATP synthase subunit e (ATP5I) in mediating the metabolic and antiproliferative effects of metformin in cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Metformin fights pancreatic cancer and osteosarcoma by targeting ATP5I protein, disrupting cancer cell energy production and blocking growth.

biomarkers.title: Circular RNAs in tumorigenesis: an insight into recent research in biogenesis and targeted tumor therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Dysregulated circular RNAs show promise as cancer biomarkers and therapeutic targets across multiple tumor types.

biomarkers.title: KIBRA impairs DNA damage repair and suppresses osteosarcoma progression by inhibiting the Wnt/β-catenin signaling activity.
biomarkers.summary: KIBRA suppresses osteosarcoma growth by blocking a key cell signaling pathway and impairing cancer cells' DNA repair ability.

biomarkers.title: RBM15B-mediated m6A modification of FOXM1 activates the AURKA/TPX2 axis to promote epithelial-mesenchymal transition-driven endometrial cancer progression.
biomarkers.summary: RBM15B protein increases endometrial cancer progression by chemically modifying FOXM1 RNA, which activates a pathway promoting cancer spread.

biomarkers.title: Chemiluminescence resonance energy transfer-based method to investigate the platelet surface molecule in acute myocardial infarction.
biomarkers.summary: A new blood test method detects elevated platelet activation markers in acute heart attack patients, potentially improving diagnosis and risk assessment.

biomarkers.title: Neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy and postoperative acute hypoxemic respiratory failure in thoracic surgery: a multicentre cohort study.
biomarkers.summary: Immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy before lung cancer surgery may increase risk of serious breathing problems after the operation.

biomarkers.title: miR-4772-3p serves as a potential diagnostic and prognostic biomarker in septic acute kidney injury by targeting CISD2.
biomarkers.summary: miR-4772-3p is elevated in septic acute kidney injury and serves as a diagnostic and prognostic biomarker by targeting CISD2.

biomarkers.title: ATOX1 alleviates radiation-induced cardiac injury by modulating AMPK/NRF2 to inhibit myocardial oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction.
biomarkers.summary: ATOX1 protein protects heart cells from radiation damage by activating a pathway that reduces harmful stress molecules and restores mitochondrial function.

biomarkers.title: CAR T-cell therapy-associated central hypothyroidism: a case of a novel onco-endocrine toxicity.
biomarkers.summary: CAR T-cell therapy for mantle cell lymphoma caused rare central hypothyroidism, likely from immune cells damaging the pituitary gland.

biomarkers.title: Metastases to the thyroid gland from uncommon primaries: a case series.
biomarkers.summary: Thyroid nodules from metastatic cancers can mimic primary thyroid cancer; immunohistochemistry helps identify the true cancer source.

biomarkers.title: Patient Perceptions and Type 1 Delay in Head and Neck Cancer: A Scoping Review of High- and Low-/Middle-Income Countries.
biomarkers.summary: Patient beliefs and attitudes delay head and neck cancer diagnosis in both wealthy and developing countries.

biomarkers.title: Metabolic crosstalk in the bladder tumor microenvironment: lactate shuttling, amino acid dependency, and immunosuppression.
biomarkers.summary: Bladder cancer cells use lactate and amino acids to suppress immune responses, suggesting metabolic targeting could improve immunotherapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Integrative bioinformatics and experimental validation reveal quercetin as a potential multi-target therapeutic agent in hepatocellular carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Quercetin, a natural compound, reduces liver cancer cell growth by targeting five key genes involved in tumor development.

biomarkers.title: Co-Culture of nasopharyngeal carcinoma cells and fibroblasts induces altered integrin expression associated with 3D structural formation.
biomarkers.summary: Combining nasopharyngeal cancer cells with fibroblasts in 3D culture creates tumor models that better mimic real tumors and show altered integrin expression patterns.

biomarkers.title: Role of genomic science in males with breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Male breast cancer risk doubles with affected relatives; genomic science enables better risk assessment and personalized treatment through nursing education.

biomarkers.title: Spatially tunable multiomic sequencing using light-driven combinatorial barcoding of molecules in tissues.
biomarkers.summary: BALI uses light to create customizable spatial barcodes on tissues, enabling high-resolution multi-omic profiling of cells in their native context.

trials.title: Relationship between spiritual pain, physical pain, and existential wellbeing among cancer patients: a correlational study.
trials.summary: Spiritual pain strongly affects cancer patients' overall well-being alongside physical pain, revealing an important gap in supportive care.

trials.title: Creative and Expressive Therapies in Head and Neck Cancer Nursing: A Scoping Review and Evidence Map.
trials.summary: Creative therapies like art and music may help improve quality of life and emotional well-being in head and neck cancer patients.

trials.title: A cohort study on inflammatory response and coagulation function changes in women with silver clip or silk ligation sterilisation.
trials.summary: Researchers studied how two tubal sterilization methods affect women's inflammation and blood clotting over time.

trials.title: Type 2 diabetes remission in gynaecologic oncology patients completing an acute preoperative weight loss protocol: a case series.
trials.summary: Gynaecologic cancer patients with obesity who lost weight before surgery experienced remission or improvement in their type 2 diabetes.

trials.title: Neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy and postoperative acute hypoxemic respiratory failure in thoracic surgery: a multicentre cohort study.
trials.summary: Immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy before lung cancer surgery may increase risk of serious breathing problems after the operation.

trials.title: CAR T-cell therapy-associated central hypothyroidism: a case of a novel onco-endocrine toxicity.
trials.summary: CAR T-cell therapy for mantle cell lymphoma caused rare central hypothyroidism, likely from immune cells damaging the pituitary gland.

trials.title: Triplet or Quadruplet Regimen Utilization and Overall Survival in Patients Diagnosed With Multiple Myeloma Between 2017 and 2023.
trials.summary: Multiple myeloma patients treated with three or four-drug combinations showed improved survival compared to standard treatments from 2017 to 2023.

trials.title: European Recommendations for Transitioning the Care of Patients With Multiple Myeloma Treated With B-Cell Maturation Antigen Bispecific Antibodies From Academic Hospitals to Community-Based Centers and for Outpatient Step-Up Dosing.
trials.summary: Researchers provide guidelines for safely treating multiple myeloma patients with new bispecific antibody drugs in community hospitals instead of academic centers.

trials.title: Role of genomic science in males with breast cancer.
trials.summary: Male breast cancer risk doubles with affected relatives; genomic science enables better risk assessment and personalized treatment through nursing education.

trials.title: [Clinical practice guideline for integrated PET/MRI in brain gliomas(2026 edition)].
trials.summary: New guidelines standardize combined PET/MRI imaging for diagnosing and treating brain gliomas in China, improving precision care.

trials.title: Effective radiofrequency thalamotomy for posttraumatic Holmes tremor: illustrative case.
trials.summary: Radiofrequency thalamotomy successfully treated Holmes tremor, a severe movement disorder caused by brain injury, offering an alternative when medications fail.

trials.title: Chainsaw culture: Cladophialophora bantiana cerebral abscess after chainsaw activity in an immunocompetent host. Illustrative case.
trials.summary: A healthy person developed a rare brain fungus infection from chainsaw use, highlighting an unusual infection risk in immunocompetent individuals.

trials.title: A rare case of intradural extramedullary anaplastic ependymoma: a 35-month survival update following resection and adjuvant proton beam radiation therapy. Illustrative case.
trials.summary: Surgery followed by proton beam radiation therapy helped a patient with a rare, aggressive spinal tumor survive 35 months.

trials.title: Survival Analysis of the WSG TP-II Trial: Neoadjuvant Trastuzumab and Pertuzumab Plus Endocrine Therapy Versus Chemotherapy in Hormone Receptor-Positive/Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2-Positive Early Breast Cancer.
trials.summary: For HER2-positive breast cancer, chemotherapy with targeted drugs achieved higher complete response rates than hormone therapy with targeted drugs.

trials.title: Rapid Transcription Dynamics Confers Cytarabine Resistance in Acute Myeloid Leukemia.
trials.summary: Rapid changes in gene activity help acute myeloid leukemia cells resist chemotherapy, and blocking these changes restores drug effectiveness.
